Subject: Notes from Yesterday’s Seminar

Hi Alex,

I had to miss yesterday’s seminar due to my part-time job shift. Would you mind sharing your notes?

Thanks,
Maya

--- Email In ---
Subject: Seminar Notes

Hi Maya,

Sure! I’ve attached my notes on the AI ethics discussion we had yesterday. It was really interesting.

Cheers,
Alex

--- Attachment ---
AI Ethics Seminar Notes  
October 2025

Prepared by: Alex J.

---

**Seminar Overview**

The seminar held on October 15, 2025, focused on current debates and developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) ethics. The session was led by Dr. Susan Kim and included presentations, group discussions, and a Q&A segment. The primary themes explored were bias in AI systems, ethical frameworks for development and deployment, transparency and accountability, and societal impacts.

Below are detailed notes from the seminar.
